name: Smooth walking croon
desc: A warm, dark sawtooth walking bass crooning a I-vi-ii-V turnaround in C major: skeletal roots that alternate footprint, a full four-to-the-bar walk with chord-tone approaches under a slow filter bloom and a gentle pump, and a peak that eighth-note walks with chromatic passing tones and lifts an octave every eighth cycle. City-pop smoke.

code.full: note("<[c2 e2 g2 a2] [a1 c2 e2 g2] [d2 f2 a2 c3] [g1 b1 d2 f2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).lpq(3).attack(.01).decay(.3).sustain(.4).release(.15).shape(.45).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.8,${gain}).fast(2)).room(${room}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[c2 e2 g2 c3 g2 e2 c2 d2] [a1 c2 e2 a2 e2 c2 a1 b1] [d2 f2 a2 d3 a2 f2 d2 eb2] [g1 b1 d2 g2 f2 d2 b1 g1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).lpq(4).attack(.01).decay(.22).sustain(.3).release(.1).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.75,${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).every(8,x=>x.add(note(12))).orbit(3).play()
